Scalar types

Source: R/numpy_misc.R
jnp_scalar_types.Rd

Ports of the jax.numpy scalar types. Each is a constructor: jnp_float32(x) is jnp_asarray(x, dtype = "float32") (64-bit types give 32-bit arrays unless x64 is enabled). They also work as dtype arguments of jnp_dtype(), jnp_issubdtype(), jnp_promote_types(), jnp_can_cast() and the info functions. jnp_int_, jnp_uint, jnp_float_ and jnp_complex_ are the 64-bit types; jnp_single, jnp_double, jnp_csingle and jnp_cdouble are aliases.

Details

The abstract types (jnp_generic, jnp_number, jnp_integer, jnp_signedinteger, jnp_unsignedinteger, jnp_inexact, jnp_floating, jnp_complexfloating, jnp_character, jnp_flexible) are category names for jnp_issubdtype().
